verdict.rationale: Ledgy documents its own exports alongside compliance reports, and a GraphQL API that returns cap table and transaction data in pages with incremental changes. Nothing shows a complete account export, the file formats, or an offboarding path. Missing for 10: a documented full-data export covering all entities and documents, an explicit open format (e.g. CSV/JSON), and offboarding/exit guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: One-click equity compliance reports, custom views and exports, make meeting compliance deadlines a breeze.
companyTransactions and companyCaptable can return a company's rows in pages, and only the rows that changed since an earlier request.
The operation user can retrieve cap table data about the queried company.
